warm_moist.why: In cool climates, warm months come from mild, moist ocean air. In hot climates, the hottest months are the dry, sunny ones.

soil_heat.region: Water-limited climates (in the warm season, evaporation follows soil water more than sunshine)
soil_heat.why: Soil can only cool the air by evaporating where soil water is what limits evaporation.

wind_frost.region: Mild-winter frost climates (coldest months average −2 to +6 °C, with frost)
wind_frost.why: Where winters are mild, frost needs a calm, clear night; wind prevents it. In deep-cold climates frost comes with cold air masses, so wind doesn't help.

soil_wind_via_heat.why: Only where dry soil makes days hotter could it stir up wind.
